vxlservices.com returns HTTP 403 to headless/automated clients but serves normal browsers fine; I overrode the browser user agent to view it, which means a real visitor experience was approximated, not the crawler experience.

Scores are relative to this batch and to a one-person consultancy's ability to serve the business, not absolute grades of business quality.
